bucket_name.title: Bucket Name
bucket_name.description: Name of the S3 bucket to use as the content source.

prefix.title: Key Prefix
prefix.description: Optional key prefix to scope the connector to a sub-path within the bucket.

delimiter.title: Delimiter
delimiter.description: Optional delimiter character used when listing objects (e.g. '/').

allowed_extensions.title: Allowed File Extensions
allowed_extensions.description: Restrict ingestion to objects whose key ends with one of these extensions.
